meta.name: programmatic-seo
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "build programmatic SEO pages" or "generate pages at scale"; designs a template × dataset page system with playbook selection, a data-defensibility tier check, and thin/duplicate guardrails. Not for finding what to target — use keyword-research or content-gap-analysis; not for writing one page — use seo-content-writer. 批量页面/程序化SEO/模板数据

copy.tagline: 批量生成程序化SEO页面，避免内容重复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用模板和数据批量生成大量SEO页面
copy.tagline_en: Generate programmatic SEO pages at scale with thin-content guardrails
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate many SEO pages from templates and data

howto.what: 这个技能会帮你设计一套「模板+数据」系统，一次性生成成百上千个SEO页面。它会选择最合适的玩法模板，检查数据质量，并设置防重复和内容过薄的规则，确保页面能被搜索引擎收录。
howto.when: 当你要求「批量生成SEO页面」或「大规模建页面」，或者需要规划程序化SEO页面系统、选择玩法模板、审核模板数据是否存在内容过薄或重复风险时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个产品对比页面的程序化SEO方案，数据来自我的产品列表。
say.note: 技能会选择一个对比玩法模板，并设计模板字段和去重规则。

say.text: 我有800个城市的数据，设计一个服务页面模板并检查内容过薄风险。
say.note: 技能会设计位置页面模板，并评估数据质量等级。

say.text: 为我的集成目录选择正确的程序化SEO玩法，并定义模板字段。
say.note: 技能会匹配集成目录玩法，并输出模板字段映射。

howto.what_en: This skill helps you design a template + dataset system to generate hundreds or thousands of SEO pages at once. It selects the best playbook, checks data defensibility, and sets guardrails against thin/duplicate content to keep pages indexable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'build programmatic SEO pages' or 'generate pages at scale', or when you need to plan a pSEO page system, pick a playbook, or audit a template-dataset for thin/duplicate risk before publishing.

say_en.text: Build a programmatic SEO plan for comparison pages from my product feed.
I have a dataset of 800 cities. Design the location-page template and flag thin-content risk.
say_en.note: The skill designs a location page template and runs a data-tier check.

say_en.text: Pick the right pSEO playbook for my integrations directory and define the template fields.
say_en.note: The skill matches the integrations playbook and outputs a template field map.
